title: From AI-Enabled Remote Patient Monitoring Toward Agentic Robotics: Embodiment, Governance, and Care Integration
abstract: arXiv:2611.18484v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI-enabled remote patient monitoring is evolving beyond passive data collection toward agentic AI systems that interpret patient states, coordinate care, and initiate action across domestic and clinical settings. This structured scoping review finds that mature agentic care has not yet emerged: Most systems remain human led, while stronger decision-action coupling and embodied AI remain largely confined to prototypes and pilots. Healthcare robotics makes the transition from monitoring to action especially visible by translating AI-generated recommendations and decisions into speech, movement, prompting, physical assistance, escalation, and care coordination, making embodiment, clinical integration, human oversight, and governance fundamental design requirements. translated_title: 从AI赋能的远程患者监测迈向智能体机器人：具身化、治理与护理整合
translated_abstract: AI赋能的远程患者监测正在从被动的数据收集演进为具有能动性的AI系统，这类系统能够解读患者状态、协调护理，并在家庭和临床环境中发起行动。这项结构化的范围综述发现，成熟的智能体护理尚未实现：大多数系统仍由人类主导，而更强的决策-行动耦合和具身AI在很大程度上仍局限于原型与试点阶段。医疗机器人通过将AI生成的建议和决策转化为语音、动作、提示、物理辅助、升级上报和护理协调，使从监测到行动的转变尤为直观，这也使具身化、临床整合、人类监督和治理成为基本的设计要求。进一步的进展需要安全且可互操作的护理架构，使智能组件能够在经过临床验证且可问责的工作流程中运行。我们提出了一种……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过结构化范围综述指出，AI远程患者监测正迈向具身智能体机器人护理，但成熟的智能体护理尚未实现，未来需要以具身化、人类监督、治理和安全可互操作的护理架构为基础，实现从监测到行动的转变。
en_tdlr: This structured scoping review finds that mature agentic care has not yet emerged—most systems remain human-led with embodied AI confined to prototypes—and argues that advancing toward agentic robotics requires embodiment, human oversight, governance, and safe, interoperable care architectures.
